description: This file defines the InboundEmail class, which manages inbound email accounts and message processing within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for connecting to email servers (IMAP and POP3), retrieving, caching, and managing emails and folders, as well as handling security and access control. The class also interfaces with external libraries for email parsing and server handling.

classes.name: InboundEmail
classes.description: Manages inbound email account configuration, server connection, email retrieval, caching, and folder management within SuiteCRM. Handles both IMAP and POP3 protocols, includes security and access control logic, and interfaces with external libraries for email parsing and server communication.
